mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when the unemployment rate is below 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of increasing industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when housing starts are above 1500 and the unemployment rate is below 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP signal an easing monetary cycle and a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 4.0 and GDP is above 11000.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when the unemployment rate is below 5.0 and payroll employment is above 130000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index and an increase in retail sales signal a decrease in inflation and an increase in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when the consumer price index is below 190 and retail sales are above 350000.
